 From Gen Z With Love: Is Robert Pattinson Really Bond Material?
 A new leading man has been chosen for one of Hollywood's most iconic franchises—and the internet has a lot to say. Is Robert Pattinson really Bond material? Vlad and Kelly go head-to-head on what it takes to be a leading man in 2026. Spoiler: they do NOT agree. From Bond traditionalists to the teenage girl index, they unpack how fandom, social media and Amazon are reshaping casting—and ask the bigger question: Is the industry choosing the right person for the role, or the biggest built-in audience?
